<function name="NamedColor" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns named color defined in `resource/ClientScheme.res`.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">Name of color</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">A <page>Color</page> or nil</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
